rca_of_the_issue: Previous failure was caused by applying bucket=pipeline before search, excluding raw Ozonetel leads with pipeline:false. The fix makes bucket filters apply only for non-search lists, so a phone/name/email search can find customers across both pipeline and raw Ozonetel buckets while default bucket counts stay unchanged. Verified with bucket=pipeline&search=5770614172 and broader search 'Lead 6000' returning both raw Ozonetel and pipeline rows.
